items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: That was me, Justin Adams, Dalton Russo, David Francois, and you know, all decent people.

ctx.x: Something we haven't really talked about, and we can get back to that, to what you did. What did your parents tell you about whites, about whites, and how to behave?

You know, okay, first of all, I can say this. You see, my family being the type of people that they were, we never did have no white problem. We never had no white. You know what, I think it's because I think being from a decent family, I think we were kind of looked on as just poor, decent people. Now there always was that other kind, that other person, you know, them other people. But my family, we never had no problem. And I say that, to say this, even during the civil rights struggle with me, playing music, I…
You were careful not to talk to anybody?
